note: Forge's debugger, checked headless: affrescoui_render_runner debug.scenarios.json. No adapter runs: the steps named debugApply* play what tests/dap/fake_adapter.py answers (its capabilities, stops, frames, variables and evaluations), as the dap service hands them to the screen.

scenarios.name: debug-view-and-configurations
scenarios.note: Run and Debug shows the folder's launch configurations (none in the example folder); a launch.json's are listed, those Forge can't run counted

steps.note: what forge.debug.launchConfigurations reads from a launch.json

scenarios.name: debug-start-without-configuration
scenarios.note: F5 with no configuration says how to add one and starts nothing

steps.note: the explorer's name field has the focus at start, and a text area keeps F5

scenarios.name: debug-launch-refused
scenarios.note: A launch the adapter refuses ends the session with one message, in the console and as a toast

expect.is: The debugger could not launch: no such file: src/main.cpp

scenarios.name: debug-breakpoints-verified
scenarios.note: Breakpoints set before the session go to the adapter when it is initialized; it verifies line 5 and not line 11 (fake_adapter: no code on this line)

steps.note: a click in the gutter of line 5

scenarios.name: debug-conditional-and-logpoint
scenarios.note: A breakpoint with a condition and a hit count, and a logpoint; the edit dialog changes them

scenarios.name: debug-stopped-stack
scenarios.note: Stopped at a breakpoint: the thread and its frames, the current line highlighted in src/main.cpp, the frame's source open

steps.note: a library frame outside the folder opens only with consent
what the adapter's source request answers once allowed

scenarios.name: debug-stepping
scenarios.note: Step over, into and out resume (frames and variables cleared) until the next stop; F10 steps over while editing

steps.note: the editor keeps the debugger's keys

scenarios.name: debug-variables-paged
scenarios.note: Scopes, the locals expanded, a 2,500-item list loaded 100 at a time (fake_adapter's items)

scenarios.name: debug-set-value
scenarios.note: Set Value on a local sends setVariable; the answer replaces the row's value

scenarios.name: debug-watches
scenarios.note: Watches evaluate in the selected frame at each stop; a name the program doesn't have shows the adapter's error

scenarios.name: debug-console
scenarios.note: The debug console evaluates in the frame, keeps a history (up and down) and completes with tab

scenarios.name: debug-exception
scenarios.note: An uncaught exception stops on line 8 with its description inline (exceptionInfo); the filters go to the adapter when toggled

scenarios.name: debug-output-and-end
scenarios.note: The program's output goes to the console; exited and terminated end the session with one line
